coverageSpotVerification.detail: Sampled 16 suite-required mappings across M1-M6 and M8 (evidence/coverage-manifest.json plus scripts/acceptance-m*.mjs); every mapped test exercises the assertion's observable against the running backend, and the suite fails closed on any unmapped suite-required ID. Weak-but-honest points (not dishonest): m2-a08 checks only a newly created post, not older ones; m2-a25 never exercises 'follows no other accounts'; m2-a20 uses a single reply so ordering is trivial; m2-a16 checks the actor handle in query data rather than the visible label; m4-a07 clears with an explicit null rather than a same-emoji tap. The grader independently re-verified each of these gaps (trace §2) and found the behavior correct. No milestone adjudicated to capability-failure.

defects.summary: Chat-settings member management only reaches the first 20 registered profiles: the add-member candidate list is built from api.allPeople (first 20 by id, no search or paging), so an admin cannot add any later-registered account, and tapping Remove on a member outside those 20 silently does nothing (the handle lookup misses; no error is shown). With 28 accounts on the grader instance the newest account was not offered and stayed a member after the UI remove; at the brief's ~1,000-user envelope only the earliest 20 accounts are reachable.
defects.evidence: trace.md §6 d-01 (web3 run: registeredProfiles 28, candidatesShown 18, lateAccountListed false, stillMemberAfterUiRemove true, errorShown []; screenshot web3-admin-reach.png); source src/chat.tsx ChatSettings (people = useQuery(api.allPeople); change() finds the handle in people.data), snapback/schema.q `query allPeople ... first 20 by byId`

defects.summary: Chat-list unread badge is computed as conversation.lastOrdinal − member.readOrdinal, so it counts the viewer's own messages sent from another device/API client and messages the peer has deleted-for-everyone (observed badge 1 after the viewer's own message from a second device, 2 after a peer sent and deleted a message).
defects.evidence: trace.md §6 d-02 (web6 run); source src/chat.tsx ChatRows unreadCount={Math.max(0, room.lastOrdinal - m.readOrdinal)}

defects.summary: Grouped global message search is not newest-first: groups come out in conversation-id order (members[viewer] ... by byPrincipal), so a chat holding the newest hit was listed after a chat whose hit was older; each group shows at most 3 hits with no per-chat continuation from the global view.
defects.evidence: trace.md §6 d-03 (web6 run: 'Older hit chat' containing the newest hit listed second); source snapback/chat.q query searchGrouped

defects.summary: The post composer stays editable while a previous post is sending and clears the field when that send settles, discarding text typed in the interim (grader automation typed a caption right after posting; the text vanished and the Publish button stayed disabled).
defects.evidence: trace.md §6 d-04 (first W2 run; web-run.log error: sm-compose-submit disabled after fill); source src/posts.tsx PostComposer.send() setBody('') after the awaited mutate

O1.anchorsCited: Between ~60 ('M1–M4 solid, later milestones patchy or failed on cap') and ~90 ('every in-scope milestone green, including platform-proof artifacts'), close to 90.
O1.justification: Full-run denominator of 119 assertions (M1–M8): 101 pass, 18 not passed. M1–M5 all pass on grader re-execution (trace §1, §3); M6 web/API items pass but its 7 native-simulator assertions have no artifact; M8 16/18 pass (2 native not recorded); M7's 9 assertions were never attempted (reserved fresh session) and count as not passed. 90 needs every in-scope milestone green including platform-proof artifacts, which fails on M7 and the missing simulator proofs.

O2.anchorsCited: Just above ~60 ('a few medium defects off the happy path'); well above ~30 ('multiple high-severity defects in core flows'); short of ~90 ('only cosmetic nits').
O2.justification: Beyond-checklist defects: one major (d-01: chat-settings add/remove reaches only the first 20 accounts and fails silently), two minor (d-02 unread badge miscount; d-03 grouped search not newest-first), one cosmetic (d-04 composer text lost while sending). No crashes, data loss or authorization defects; all 50+ grader API trust checks behaved correctly (trace §3.3).

O3.anchorsCited: Toward ~90 ('every probe correctly denied, including asset access after view-once/delete'); held below it because the scored input — the wave's committed rotated holdout set — does not exist.
O3.justification: Deviation: no probe set was committed for this wave, so no rotated holdout probes ran (probeResults empty). Placement uses the grader's own phase-3/5 trust checks, which cover every published category: cross-user DM/history/search/typers/roster access (denied/empty), removed-member delivery and assets (denied), view-once re-fetch (410; range 416; outsider 404), delete-for-everyone assets (404), expired edit/delete windows (EDIT_WINDOW_CLOSED / DELETE_WINDOW_CLOSED), session invalidation after logout/logout-all/refresh (401), server-side denials surviving the offline web cache, and digest authorization (trace §3.3, §3.2 W6, §3.5). Every check was denied correctly. Posture note: `snapback4 dev` admits loopback persona headers and an unauthenticated /seed by design (dev-only platform features, not exercised as app defects).

O4.anchorsCited: Between ~30 ('cold-start offline shows an empty or broken app') and ~60 ('reads work; offline writes lost or mis-ordered, or receipts wrong after flush'); the ~90 anchor is defined 'on the native proof', which is absent.
O4.justification: O4 inputs are harness choreography artifacts only. No iOS-simulator recording or receipt exists for M6 or M8 (supplementalExternal not-recorded), so cold-start offline reads, offline media, cold offline search, view-once non-rendering and the M8 durable-queue restart were never demonstrated on the native proof. Harness web receipts (lane and grader runs) do demonstrate warm-offline search (M5), two offline messages with visible pending state flushing in order and reaching read (M6 web), same-account live delivery, cross-device read state and dual-offline convergence with normal receipts (M8). The run record states the gap honestly ('Native proof is Hermes export, not simulator evidence').

O5.bandRationale: First-match 0,30,60,90,75 on the available inputs. 0 not fired: the lane's replay record reports pass with all counts, per-chat counts and named O5 fixtures verified (evidence/scale-final-verification.json), and the grader's own clone of the final store matched every checked invariant (u0500 500 follows/100 conversations, u0005 5, u0900 900 followers/200 posts, u0901's 5 followed accounts, g0001's exact 50-member roster and 10,000 messages by full paging, 10 sampled non-empty chats, 10 sampled following counts, 7 named spot posts); the replay completed (3378 s replay time) and no calibrated wall cap exists to exhaust. 30 not fired: grader-measured degradation rules at the 100% checkpoint (k=20 after 3 warm-ups, sequential, 30 s timeout) all pass — busy-chat page 50/page 1 p95 0.95x, 500-follow/5-follow Following 1.16x, celebrity/5-follower post-create 1.53x, celebrity-follower/5-follow Following 1.08x, 50-member/2-member send 0.63x; cold initial sync of u0500 completed in 1.3 s (200,044 events); no probe timed out, errored or OOMed. The three cross-checkpoint rules (search, Insights, Trending growth vs 10%) could not be measured (no committed probe set, no checkpoint stores). 60 not fired: no absolute ceilings or replay cap were calibrated (brief table is placeholder), so neither can be exceeded. 90 not met: ceiling utilization and cap usage cannot be established without calibrated ceilings/cap. Falls to 75. The wave's rotated performance probes never ran.

notes: N=1 calibration run, grade labeled uncalibrated-grader (Claude family has not passed calibration.md). probeResults is empty by design: no holdout probe set was committed for this wave (probeSetSha256 = none-uncommitted), execution-order phase 4 was skipped, and no probes were invented; grader-authored trust and performance checks are reported in the trace and in assertion/defect evidence, never as probe results. The frozen schema admits only m1-m7 assertion IDs, so the 18 M8 results are in grading/m8-assertion-results.json (the two files partition all 119 IDs). rerunsUsed=1: two grader-script faults (a typing race in web step W2 and a wrong DM lookup in the scale send probe) were fixed and those steps re-run once; neither was a lane defect. Timing checks record machine load in the trace (shared host, 1-minute load ~8-13). Subtotals are left to the harness.
